import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os

# ============================================================
# STEP 1: DATASET LOADING AND INITIAL VERIFICATION
# ============================================================

# Dataset path
dataset_path = r"E:\Projects\1_Material Manufacturing\Dataset\C_Dataset.csv"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Check whether the file exists
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if not os.path.exists(dataset_path):
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"Dataset not found at:\n{dataset_path}\n\n"
        "Please verify the path and filename."
    )

print("=" * 80)
print("STEP 1: DATASET LOADING AND INITIAL VERIFICATION")
print("=" * 80)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------
df = pd.read_csv(dataset_path)

print("\nDataset successfully loaded.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Dataset dimensions
# ------------------------------------------------------------
print("\n" + "-" * 80)
print("DATASET DIMENSIONS")
print("-" * 80)

print(f"Number of records : {df.shape[0]:,}")
print(f"Number of columns : {df.shape[1]:,}")
print(f"Dataset shape     : {df.shape}")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Display column names
# ------------------------------------------------------------
print("\n" + "-" * 80)
print("COLUMN INFORMATION")
print("-" * 80)

for i, column in enumerate(df.columns, start=1):
    print(f"{i:3d}. {column}")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Display data types
# ------------------------------------------------------------
print("\n" + "-" * 80)
print("DATA TYPES")
print("-" * 80)

dtype_table = pd.DataFrame({
    "Column": df.columns,
    "Data_Type": df.dtypes.astype(str).values,
    "Non_Null_Count": df.notna().sum().values,
    "Missing_Count": df.isna().sum().values,
    "Unique_Values": df.nunique(dropna=True).values
})

print(dtype_table.to_string(index=False))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. First five records
# ------------------------------------------------------------
print("\n" + "-" * 80)
print("FIRST 5 RECORDS")
print("-" * 80)

print(df.head())

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Last five records
# ------------------------------------------------------------
print("\n" + "-" * 80)
print("LAST 5 RECORDS")
print("-" * 80)

print(df.tail().to_string())

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Missing-value summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------
print("\n" + "-" * 80)
print("MISSING-VALUE SUMMARY")
print("-" * 80)

missing_summary = pd.DataFrame({
    "Column": df.columns,
    "Missing_Count": df.isna().sum().values,
    "Missing_Percentage": (
        df.isna().mean().values * 100
    )
})

missing_summary = missing_summary.sort_values(
    by="Missing_Count",
    ascending=False
)

print(missing_summary.to_string(index=False))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Duplicate records
# ------------------------------------------------------------
duplicate_count = df.duplicated().sum()

print("\n" + "-" * 80)
print("DUPLICATE RECORD CHECK")
print("-" * 80)

print(f"Duplicate records : {duplicate_count:,}")
print(
    f"Duplicate percentage : "
    f"{(duplicate_count / len(df)) * 100:.4f}%"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Numerical and categorical columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------
numeric_columns = df.select_dtypes(
    include=np.number
).columns.tolist()

categorical_columns = df.select_dtypes(
    exclude=np.number
).columns.tolist()

print("\n" + "-" * 80)
print("FEATURE TYPE SUMMARY")
print("-" * 80)

print(f"Numerical columns   : {len(numeric_columns)}")
print(f"Categorical columns : {len(categorical_columns)}")

print("\nNumerical columns:")
for col in numeric_columns:
    print(f"  - {col}")

print("\nCategorical columns:")
for col in categorical_columns:
    print(f"  - {col}")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Numerical descriptive statistics
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if len(numeric_columns) > 0:

    print("\n" + "-" * 80)
    print("NUMERICAL DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS")
    print("-" * 80)

    print(
        df[numeric_columns]
        .describe()
        .T
        .to_string()
    )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Categorical-value summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if len(categorical_columns) > 0:

    print("\n" + "-" * 80)
    print("CATEGORICAL FEATURE SUMMARY")
    print("-" * 80)

    for col in categorical_columns:
        print(f"\n[{col}]")
        print(df[col].value_counts(dropna=False).head(20).to_string())

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Basic memory information
# ------------------------------------------------------------
memory_mb = df.memory_usage(deep=True).sum() / (1024 ** 2)

print("\n" + "-" * 80)
print("MEMORY USAGE")
print("-" * 80)

print(f"Dataset memory usage : {memory_mb:.2f} MB")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Final Step-1 summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------
print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("STEP 1 COMPLETED")
print("=" * 80)

print(f"Records              : {df.shape[0]:,}")
print(f"Columns              : {df.shape[1]:,}")
print(f"Numerical features   : {len(numeric_columns)}")
print(f"Categorical features : {len(categorical_columns)}")
print(f"Missing cells        : {df.isna().sum().sum():,}")
print(f"Duplicate records    : {duplicate_count:,}")
print(f"Memory usage         : {memory_mb:.2f} MB")
print("=" * 80)

# ============================================================
# STEP 2 + STEP 3 + STEP 4
# DATA CLEANING + KNN IMPUTATION + Z-SCORE STANDARDIZATION
# ============================================================

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.impute import KNNImputer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler


# ============================================================
# PATHS
# ============================================================

input_path = r"E:\Projects\1_Material Manufacturing\Dataset\C_Dataset.csv"

output_path = (
    r"E:\Projects\1_Material Manufacturing\Dataset\C_Dataset_preprocessed.csv"
)


# ============================================================
# STEP 2: DATA CLEANING AND QUALITY CHECKING
# ============================================================

print("=" * 90)
print(" DATA CLEANING")
print("=" * 90)

# Check input file
if not os.path.exists(input_path):
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"\nInput dataset was not found:\n{input_path}"
    )

# Load dataset
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.1 Remove completely empty rows
# ------------------------------------------------------------

empty_rows = df.isna().all(axis=1).sum()

if empty_rows > 0:
    df = df.dropna(how="all").reset_index(drop=True)

print(f"\nCompletely empty rows removed: {empty_rows}")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.2 Remove completely empty columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

empty_columns = df.columns[df.isna().all()].tolist()

if len(empty_columns) > 0:
    df = df.drop(columns=empty_columns)

print(f"Completely empty columns removed: {len(empty_columns)}")

if empty_columns:
    print("Removed columns:")
    for col in empty_columns:
        print("  -", col)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.3 Remove duplicate records
# ------------------------------------------------------------

duplicate_count = df.duplicated().sum()

if duplicate_count > 0:
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.4 Clean column names
# ------------------------------------------------------------

df.columns = (
    df.columns
    .astype(str)
    .str.strip()
    .str.replace(r"\s+", "_", regex=True)
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.5 Convert common missing-value representations to NaN
# ------------------------------------------------------------

missing_tokens = [
    "",
    " ",
    "NA",
    "N/A",
    "na",
    "n/a",
    "NULL",
    "null",
    "None",
    "none",
    "?",
    "-",
    "--"
]

df = df.replace(missing_tokens, np.nan)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.6 Convert numeric-looking object columns to numeric
# ------------------------------------------------------------

for col in df.columns:

    if df[col].dtype == "object":

        converted = pd.to_numeric(
            df[col],
            errors="coerce"
        )

        # Convert only when most non-null values are numeric
        non_null_count = df[col].notna().sum()

        if non_null_count > 0:

            numeric_count = converted.notna().sum()

            if numeric_count / non_null_count >= 0.80:
                df[col] = converted


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.7 Identify target column
# ------------------------------------------------------------

target_candidates = [
    "IEC_Alignment_Class",
    "Professional_Competency_Index"
]

target_column = None

for col in target_candidates:
    if col in df.columns:
        target_column = col
        break


if target_column is None:

    print("\nWARNING:")
    print("No predefined target column was detected.")
    print("The preprocessing will exclude obvious ID columns")
    print("but will not automatically select a target.")

else:

    print(f"\nTarget column detected: {target_column}")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.8 Identify ID columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

id_columns = []

for col in df.columns:

    col_lower = col.lower()

    if (
        col_lower == "id"
        or col_lower.endswith("_id")
        or col_lower.startswith("id_")
        or "student_id" in col_lower
        or "record_id" in col_lower
    ):
        id_columns.append(col)



# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.9 Missing-value report before imputation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

missing_before = df.isna().sum()

print("\nMissing values before KNN imputation:")

missing_before_nonzero = missing_before[
    missing_before > 0
]

if len(missing_before_nonzero) == 0:

    print("  No missing values found.")

else:

    print(
        missing_before_nonzero
        .sort_values(ascending=False)
        .to_string()
    )


# ============================================================
# PREPARE FEATURES FOR KNN IMPUTATION
# ============================================================

# Preserve target separately
if target_column is not None:

    target = df[target_column].copy()

    feature_df = df.drop(
        columns=[target_column]
    ).copy()

else:

    target = None
    feature_df = df.copy()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Separate ID columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

existing_id_columns = [
    col for col in id_columns
    if col in feature_df.columns
]

id_data = feature_df[existing_id_columns].copy()

feature_df = feature_df.drop(
    columns=existing_id_columns,
    errors="ignore"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Identify numeric and categorical predictors
# ------------------------------------------------------------

numeric_columns = feature_df.select_dtypes(
    include=np.number
).columns.tolist()

categorical_columns = feature_df.select_dtypes(
    exclude=np.number
).columns.tolist()


# ============================================================
# STEP 3: KNN IMPUTATION
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 90)
print(" KNN IMPUTATION")
print("=" * 90)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# KNN works directly on numerical predictors.
#
# For categorical columns:
# - preserve them unchanged
# - fill missing categorical values using mode
#
# Numerical columns:
# - KNN imputation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

numeric_data = feature_df[numeric_columns].copy()

categorical_data = feature_df[categorical_columns].copy()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# KNN imputation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if len(numeric_columns) > 0:

    # Number of neighbors
    K_NEIGHBORS = 5

    print(
        f"\nKNN Imputation parameters:"
        f"\n  Number of neighbors (k): {K_NEIGHBORS}"
    )

    imputer = KNNImputer(
        n_neighbors=K_NEIGHBORS,
        weights="distance"
    )

    numeric_imputed_array = imputer.fit_transform(
        numeric_data
    )

    numeric_imputed = pd.DataFrame(
        numeric_imputed_array,
        columns=numeric_columns,
        index=feature_df.index
    )

else:

    numeric_imputed = pd.DataFrame(
        index=feature_df.index
    )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Categorical missing-value handling
# ------------------------------------------------------------

for col in categorical_columns:

    if categorical_data[col].isna().any():

        mode_values = categorical_data[col].mode(
            dropna=True
        )

        if len(mode_values) > 0:

            categorical_data[col] = (
                categorical_data[col]
                .fillna(mode_values.iloc[0])
            )

        else:

            categorical_data[col] = (
                categorical_data[col]
                .fillna("Unknown")
            )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Recombine numerical and categorical features
# ------------------------------------------------------------

processed_features = pd.concat(
    [
        numeric_imputed,
        categorical_data
    ],
    axis=1
)

# Restore original feature order
processed_features = processed_features[
    feature_df.columns
]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Missing-value verification
# ------------------------------------------------------------

remaining_missing = processed_features.isna().sum().sum()

print(
    f"\nRemaining missing feature values after KNN: "
    f"{remaining_missing}"
)


# ============================================================
# STEP 4: Z-SCORE STANDARDIZATION
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 90)
print("Z-SCORE STANDARDIZATION")
print("=" * 90)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Standardize numerical features
#
# Formula:
#
#       Z = (X - mean) / standard deviation
#
# Categorical features are not standardized.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if len(numeric_columns) > 0:

    scaler = StandardScaler()

    scaled_array = scaler.fit_transform(
        processed_features[numeric_columns]
    )

    scaled_numeric = pd.DataFrame(
        scaled_array,
        columns=numeric_columns,
        index=processed_features.index
    )

else:

    scaled_numeric = pd.DataFrame(
        index=processed_features.index
    )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine standardized numerical and categorical features
# ------------------------------------------------------------

final_features = pd.concat(
    [
        scaled_numeric,
        processed_features[categorical_columns]
    ],
    axis=1
)


# Restore original predictor order
final_features = final_features[
    processed_features.columns
]


# ============================================================
# RECONSTRUCT FINAL DATASET
# ============================================================

final_df_parts = []


# ID columns first
if len(existing_id_columns) > 0:

    final_df_parts.append(
        id_data.reset_index(drop=True)
    )


# Processed features
final_df_parts.append(
    final_features.reset_index(drop=True)
)


# Target column last
if target is not None:

    final_df_parts.append(
        target.reset_index(drop=True)
    )


# Combine everything
final_df = pd.concat(
    final_df_parts,
    axis=1
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Verify standardized numerical features
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if len(numeric_columns) > 0:

    verification = pd.DataFrame({
        "Mean_After_Scaling":
            final_df[numeric_columns].mean(),

        "Std_After_Scaling":
            final_df[numeric_columns].std()
    })

    print("\nZ-score verification:")
    print(verification.round(4).to_string())


# ============================================================
# SAVE PREPROCESSED DATASET
# ============================================================

output_directory = os.path.dirname(output_path)

os.makedirs(
    output_directory,
    exist_ok=True
)

final_df.to_csv(
    output_path,
    index=False
)


# ============================================================
# VERIFY SAVED FILE
# ============================================================

if os.path.exists(output_path):

    file_size_mb = (
        os.path.getsize(output_path)
        / (1024 ** 2)
    )

    print("\n" + "=" * 90)
    print("PREPROCESSING COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY")
    print("=" * 90)

    print(
        f"\nSaved file:\n{output_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"\nFile size: {file_size_mb:.2f} MB"
    )

    print(
        f"Final dataset shape: {final_df.shape}"
    )

else:

    print(
        "\nERROR: Preprocessed file was not created."
    )


# ============================================================
# DISPLAY SAMPLE
# ============================================================

print("\nFirst 5 preprocessed records:")
print(final_df.shape)
print(
    final_df.head()
)

import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

# ============================================================
# STEP 5: PCA FEATURE EXTRACTION
# ============================================================

# -----------------------------
# File paths
# -----------------------------
input_file = r"E:\Projects\1_Material Manufacturing\Dataset\C_Dataset_preprocessed.csv"

output_file = r"E:\Projects\1_Material Manufacturing\Dataset\C_Dataset_feature_extracted.csv"

# -----------------------------
# Check input file
# -----------------------------
if not os.path.exists(input_file):
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"Preprocessed file not found:\n{input_file}\n\n"
        "Please make sure Step 2-4 was completed successfully."
    )

# -----------------------------
# Load dataset
# -----------------------------
df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

print("=" * 80)
print(" PCA FEATURE EXTRACTION")
print("=" * 80)

# ============================================================
# 1. IDENTIFY TARGET COLUMN
# ============================================================

target_candidates = [
    "IEC_Alignment_Class",
    "Professional_Competency_Index"
]

target_col = None

for col in target_candidates:
    if col in df.columns:
        target_col = col
        break

if target_col is None:
    raise ValueError(
        "Target column not found.\n"
        "Expected one of:\n"
        f"{target_candidates}"
    )


# ============================================================
# 2. IDENTIFY ID COLUMNS
# ============================================================

id_cols = []

for col in df.columns:
    col_lower = col.lower()

    if (
        col_lower == "id"
        or col_lower.endswith("_id")
        or col_lower.startswith("id_")
        or "student_id" in col_lower
        or "record_id" in col_lower
    ):
        if col != target_col:
            id_cols.append(col)

# ============================================================
# 3. SEPARATE TARGET
# ============================================================

target = df[target_col].copy()

# ============================================================
# 4. SELECT NUMERICAL PREDICTOR FEATURES
# ============================================================

exclude_cols = id_cols + [target_col]

feature_df = df.drop(columns=exclude_cols, errors="ignore")

# Select only numerical columns
numeric_features = feature_df.select_dtypes(
    include=[np.number]
).columns.tolist()

if len(numeric_features) < 15:
    raise ValueError(
        f"\nOnly {len(numeric_features)} numerical predictor features "
        "are available.\n"
        "PCA cannot produce 20 components. "
        "Please check the preprocessed dataset."
    )

X = feature_df[numeric_features].copy()

# ============================================================
# 5. CHECK MISSING VALUES
# ============================================================

missing_total = X.isna().sum().sum()

print("\nTotal missing values in PCA input:")
print(missing_total)

if missing_total > 0:
    raise ValueError(
        "Missing values are still present in the PCA input. "
        "Please complete Step 3 KNN imputation before Step 5."
    )

# ============================================================
# 6. CHECK INFINITE VALUES
# ============================================================

if np.isinf(X.to_numpy()).any():
    raise ValueError(
        "Infinite values detected in PCA input. "
        "Please clean the preprocessed dataset first."
    )

# ============================================================
# 7. PCA FEATURE EXTRACTION
# ============================================================

n_components = 15

print("\nApplying PCA...")
print(f"Requested PCA components: {n_components}")

pca = PCA(
    n_components=n_components,
    random_state=42
)

X_pca = pca.fit_transform(X)

# ============================================================
# 8. CREATE PCA FEATURE DATAFRAME
# ============================================================

pca_columns = [
    f"PCA_{i}"
    for i in range(1, n_components + 1)
]

pca_df = pd.DataFrame(
    X_pca,
    columns=pca_columns,
    index=df.index
)

# ============================================================
# 9. RECONSTRUCT FINAL DATASET
# ============================================================

final_parts = []

# Keep ID columns
if id_cols:
    final_parts.append(df[id_cols].reset_index(drop=True))

# Add PCA features
final_parts.append(
    pca_df.reset_index(drop=True)
)

# Add target
final_parts.append(
    target.reset_index(drop=True).to_frame()
)

feature_extracted_df = pd.concat(
    final_parts,
    axis=1
)

# ============================================================
# 10. PCA EXPLAINED VARIANCE
# ============================================================

explained_variance = pca.explained_variance_ratio_

cumulative_variance = np.cumsum(
    explained_variance
)

variance_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "Component": pca_columns,
    "Explained_Variance_Ratio": explained_variance,
    "Explained_Variance_Percentage": explained_variance * 100,
    "Cumulative_Variance_Percentage": cumulative_variance * 100
})

# ============================================================
# 11. DISPLAY PCA RESULTS
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("PCA RESULTS")
print("=" * 80)

print("\nPCA feature shape:")
print(X_pca.shape)

print("\nExplained variance by component:")
print(variance_df.to_string(index=False))

print("\nTotal variance explained by 20 PCA components:")
print(f"{cumulative_variance[-1] * 100:.2f}%")

# ============================================================
# 12. CHECK FINAL DATASET
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("FINAL FEATURE-EXTRACTED DATASET")
print("=" * 80)

print("\nShape:")
print(feature_extracted_df.shape)

print("\nFirst 5 rows:")
print(feature_extracted_df.head())

# ============================================================
# 14. SAVE FEATURE-EXTRACTED CSV
# ============================================================

feature_extracted_df.to_csv(
    output_file,
    index=False
)

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("FEATURE-EXTRACTION COMPLETED")
print("=" * 80)

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# ============================================================
# STEP 6: FIXED-LENGTH SEQUENCE CONSTRUCTION
# OUTPUT: ONE CSV FILE ONLY
# ============================================================

INPUT_FILE = (
    r"E:\Projects\1_Material Manufacturing\Dataset"
    r"\C_Dataset_feature_extracted.csv"
)

OUTPUT_FILE = (
    r"E:\Projects\1_Material Manufacturing\Dataset"
    r"\C_Dataset_sequence_feature_extracted.csv"
)

SEQUENCE_LENGTH = 50
TARGET_COL = "IEC_Alignment_Class"

# ============================================================
# 1. LOAD DATASET
# ============================================================

if not os.path.exists(INPUT_FILE):
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"Input file not found:\n{INPUT_FILE}"
    )

df = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)

print("=" * 80)
print("STEP 6: FIXED-LENGTH SEQUENCE CONSTRUCTION")
print("=" * 80)

print("\nInput file:")
print(INPUT_FILE)

print("\nInput shape:")
print(df.shape)

print("\nColumns:")
print(df.columns.tolist())

# ============================================================
# 2. IDENTIFY STUDENT ID
# ============================================================

student_candidates = [
    "Student_ID",
    "student_id",
    "StudentID",
    "studentid"
]

student_col = None

for col in student_candidates:
    if col in df.columns:
        student_col = col
        break

if student_col is None:
    for col in df.columns:
        if "student" in col.lower() and "id" in col.lower():
            student_col = col
            break

if student_col is None:
    raise ValueError(
        "Student ID column was not found."
    )

print("\nStudent ID column:")
print(student_col)

# ============================================================
# 3. AUTOMATICALLY DETECT PCA FEATURES
# ============================================================

pca_features = []

for col in df.columns:

    if col.startswith("PCA_"):

        try:
            number = int(col.replace("PCA_", ""))
            pca_features.append((number, col))

        except ValueError:
            pass

pca_features = [
    col
    for number, col in sorted(
        pca_features,
        key=lambda x: x[0]
    )
]

if len(pca_features) == 0:
    raise ValueError(
        "No PCA features were found."
    )

print("\nPCA features detected:")
print(pca_features)

print("\nNumber of PCA features:")
print(len(pca_features))

# ============================================================
# 4. TARGET CHECK
# ============================================================

if TARGET_COL not in df.columns:
    raise ValueError(
        f"Target column '{TARGET_COL}' not found."
    )

# ============================================================
# 5. CHECK MISSING VALUES
# ============================================================

required_columns = (
    [student_col]
    + pca_features
    + [TARGET_COL]
)

missing_values = (
    df[required_columns]
    .isna()
    .sum()
    .sum()
)

print("\nMissing values:")
print(missing_values)

if missing_values > 0:
    raise ValueError(
        "Missing values detected. "
        "Please complete preprocessing before Step 6."
    )

# ============================================================
# 6. OBSERVATIONS PER STUDENT
# ============================================================

student_counts = (
    df.groupby(student_col)
      .size()
      .sort_values()
)

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("STUDENT OBSERVATION DISTRIBUTION")
print("=" * 80)

print("\nNumber of students:")
print(len(student_counts))

print("\nObservation statistics:")
print(student_counts.describe())

print("\nStudents with exactly 50 observations:")
print(
    (student_counts == SEQUENCE_LENGTH).sum()
)

print("\nStudents with fewer than 50 observations:")
print(
    (student_counts < SEQUENCE_LENGTH).sum()
)

print("\nStudents with more than 50 observations:")
print(
    (student_counts > SEQUENCE_LENGTH).sum()
)

# ============================================================
# 7. CREATE SEQUENCES
# ============================================================

sequence_rows = []

sequence_id = 1

valid_students = student_counts[
    student_counts >= SEQUENCE_LENGTH
].index

for student_id in valid_students:

    student_data = df[
        df[student_col] == student_id
    ].copy()

    # Preserve original row order
    student_data = student_data.reset_index(drop=True)

    n_observations = len(student_data)

    # Number of complete 50-observation sequences
    n_sequences = (
        n_observations // SEQUENCE_LENGTH
    )

    for seq_idx in range(n_sequences):

        start = (
            seq_idx
            * SEQUENCE_LENGTH
        )

        end = (
            start
            + SEQUENCE_LENGTH
        )

        sequence = student_data.iloc[
            start:end
        ]

        if len(sequence) != SEQUENCE_LENGTH:
            continue

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Sequence-level target
        # ----------------------------------------------------
        #
        # Uses the target of the final observation.
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        target = sequence[
            TARGET_COL
        ].iloc[-1]

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Create ONE ROW for each sequence
        # ----------------------------------------------------
        #
        # PCA features are flattened:
        #
        # PCA_1_Obs_1 ... PCA_15_Obs_1
        # PCA_1_Obs_2 ... PCA_15_Obs_2
        # ...
        # PCA_1_Obs_50 ... PCA_15_Obs_50
        #
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        row = {
            "Sequence_ID": sequence_id,
            "Student_ID": student_id,
            "Sequence_Index": seq_idx + 1,
            "Sequence_Length": SEQUENCE_LENGTH
        }

        # Add every PCA feature for every observation
        for obs_num in range(SEQUENCE_LENGTH):

            observation = sequence.iloc[obs_num]

            for feature in pca_features:

                column_name = (
                    f"{feature}_Obs_{obs_num + 1}"
                )

                row[column_name] = (
                    observation[feature]
                )

        # Add target at the end
        row[TARGET_COL] = target

        sequence_rows.append(row)

        sequence_id += 1

# ============================================================
# 8. CREATE FINAL SEQUENCE DATAFRAME
# ============================================================

sequence_df = pd.DataFrame(
    sequence_rows
)

# ============================================================
# 9. CHECK RESULTS
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("SEQUENCE CONSTRUCTION RESULTS")
print("=" * 80)

print("\nNumber of sequences:")
print(len(sequence_df))

print("\nFinal CSV shape:")
print(sequence_df.shape)

print("\nNumber of PCA features per observation:")
print(len(pca_features))

print("\nSequence length:")
print(SEQUENCE_LENGTH)

print("\nTotal sequence feature values:")
print(
    len(pca_features)
    * SEQUENCE_LENGTH
)

# ============================================================
# 10. VERIFY EXPECTED NUMBER OF COLUMNS
# ============================================================

expected_columns = (
    4
    + (
        len(pca_features)
        * SEQUENCE_LENGTH
    )
    + 1
)

print("\nExpected number of columns:")
print(expected_columns)

print("Actual number of columns:")
print(sequence_df.shape[1])

# ============================================================
# 11. CHECK MISSING VALUES
# ============================================================

final_missing = (
    sequence_df
    .isna()
    .sum()
    .sum()
)

print("\nMissing values in final dataset:")
print(final_missing)

# ============================================================
# 12. CHECK DUPLICATES
# ============================================================

duplicates = sequence_df.duplicated().sum()

print("\nDuplicate sequences:")
print(duplicates)

# ============================================================
# 13. TARGET DISTRIBUTION
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("TARGET DISTRIBUTION")
print("=" * 80)

print(
    sequence_df[TARGET_COL]
    .value_counts()
    .sort_index()
)

# ============================================================
# 14. SAVE ONE CSV ONLY
# ============================================================

sequence_df.to_csv(
    OUTPUT_FILE,
    index=False
)

# ============================================================
# 15. VERIFY SAVED FILE
# ============================================================

if os.path.exists(OUTPUT_FILE):

    saved_df = pd.read_csv(
        OUTPUT_FILE,
        nrows=5
    )

    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("STEP 6 COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY")
    print("=" * 80)

    print("\nSaved file:")
    print(OUTPUT_FILE)

    print("\nFinal dataset shape:")
    print(sequence_df.shape)

    print("\nSaved file verified:")
    print("YES")

    print("\nFirst 5 rows:")
    print(saved_df.head())

else:

    raise IOError(
        "The output CSV could not be created."
    )

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("ONLY ONE OUTPUT FILE WAS CREATED")
print("=" * 80)

print(OUTPUT_FILE)

# ============================================================
# STEP 6: FIXED-LENGTH SEQUENCE CONSTRUCTION
# KEEP ALL 10,000 OBSERVATIONS
# OUTPUT: ONE CSV FILE ONLY
# ============================================================

import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# ============================================================
# 1. FILE PATHS
# ============================================================

INPUT_FILE = (
    r"E:\Projects\1_Material Manufacturing\Dataset"
    r"\C_Dataset_feature_extracted.csv"
)

OUTPUT_FILE = (
    r"E:\Projects\1_Material Manufacturing\Dataset"
    r"\C_Dataset_sequence_feature_extracted.csv"
)

SEQUENCE_LENGTH = 50

TARGET_COL = "IEC_Alignment_Class"

# ============================================================
# 2. CHECK INPUT FILE
# ============================================================

if not os.path.exists(INPUT_FILE):

    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"Input file not found:\n{INPUT_FILE}"
    )

# ============================================================
# 3. LOAD DATA
# ============================================================

df = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)

print("=" * 80)
print("STEP 6: FIXED-LENGTH SEQUENCE CONSTRUCTION")
print("=" * 80)

print("\nInput file:")
print(INPUT_FILE)

print("\nInput shape:")
print(df.shape)

print("\nInput columns:")
print(df.columns.tolist())

# ============================================================
# 4. IDENTIFY STUDENT ID
# ============================================================

student_candidates = [
    "Student_ID",
    "student_id",
    "StudentID",
    "studentid"
]

student_col = None

for col in student_candidates:

    if col in df.columns:

        student_col = col
        break

if student_col is None:

    for col in df.columns:

        if (
            "student" in col.lower()
            and "id" in col.lower()
        ):

            student_col = col
            break

if student_col is None:

    raise ValueError(
        "Student ID column was not found."
    )

print("\nStudent ID column:")
print(student_col)

# ============================================================
# 5. DETECT PCA FEATURES
# ============================================================

pca_features = []

for col in df.columns:

    if (
        col.startswith("PCA_")
        and "_Obs_" not in col
    ):

        try:

            number = int(
                col.replace("PCA_", "")
            )

            pca_features.append(
                (number, col)
            )

        except ValueError:

            pass

pca_features = [
    col
    for number, col in sorted(
        pca_features,
        key=lambda x: x[0]
    )
]

if len(pca_features) == 0:

    raise ValueError(
        "No PCA features were detected."
    )

print("\nPCA features:")
print(pca_features)

print("\nNumber of PCA features:")
print(len(pca_features))

# ============================================================
# 6. TARGET CHECK
# ============================================================

if TARGET_COL not in df.columns:

    raise ValueError(
        f"Target column '{TARGET_COL}' "
        "was not found."
    )

# ============================================================
# 7. CHECK ORIGINAL DATA
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("ORIGINAL DATA VALIDATION")
print("=" * 80)

print("\nOriginal observations:")
print(len(df))

print("\nUnique students:")
print(
    df[student_col].nunique()
)

# ============================================================
# 8. CHECK OBSERVATIONS PER STUDENT
# ============================================================

student_counts = (
    df.groupby(student_col)
      .size()
      .sort_index()
)

print("\nObservations per student:")
print(
    student_counts.value_counts()
    .sort_index()
)

# ============================================================
# 9. VERIFY 50 OBSERVATIONS PER STUDENT
# ============================================================

incorrect_students = student_counts[
    student_counts != SEQUENCE_LENGTH
]

if len(incorrect_students) > 0:

    print("\nWARNING:")
    print(
        "Some students do not have exactly "
        f"{SEQUENCE_LENGTH} observations."
    )

    print(
        incorrect_students
    )

else:

    print(
        "\nAll students have exactly "
        f"{SEQUENCE_LENGTH} observations."
    )

# ============================================================
# 10. PRESERVE ORIGINAL ROW ORDER
# ============================================================

df = df.copy()

df["_Original_Row_Order"] = np.arange(
    len(df)
)

# ============================================================
# 11. CREATE SEQUENCE INFORMATION
# ============================================================

# Since every student has exactly 50 observations,
# each student becomes one fixed-length sequence.

student_sequence_map = {
    student_id: sequence_id
    for sequence_id, student_id
    in enumerate(
        df[student_col].drop_duplicates(),
        start=1
    )
}

df["Sequence_ID"] = (
    df[student_col]
    .map(student_sequence_map)
)

# ============================================================
# 12. CREATE TIME STEP
# ============================================================

df["Time_Step"] = (
    df.groupby(
        "Sequence_ID"
    ).cumcount() + 1
)

# ============================================================
# 13. VERIFY TIME STEPS
# ============================================================

time_step_counts = (
    df.groupby("Sequence_ID")
      ["Time_Step"]
      .agg(
          Minimum="min",
          Maximum="max",
          Count="count"
      )
)

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("SEQUENCE VALIDATION")
print("=" * 80)

print("\nSequence count:")
print(
    df["Sequence_ID"].nunique()
)

print("\nSequence length statistics:")
print(
    time_step_counts["Count"].describe()
)

# ============================================================
# 14. VERIFY EVERY SEQUENCE HAS 50 OBSERVATIONS
# ============================================================

invalid_sequences = time_step_counts[
    (
        time_step_counts["Count"]
        != SEQUENCE_LENGTH
    )
    |
    (
        time_step_counts["Minimum"]
        != 1
    )
    |
    (
        time_step_counts["Maximum"]
        != SEQUENCE_LENGTH
    )
]

if len(invalid_sequences) > 0:

    raise ValueError(
        "Invalid fixed-length sequences detected."
    )

print(
    "\nAll sequences contain exactly "
    f"{SEQUENCE_LENGTH} observations."
)

# ============================================================
# 15. CHECK MISSING VALUES
# ============================================================

check_columns = (
    [student_col]
    + pca_features
    + [TARGET_COL]
)

missing_values = (
    df[check_columns]
    .isna()
    .sum()
    .sum()
)

print("\nMissing values:")
print(missing_values)

if missing_values > 0:

    raise ValueError(
        "Missing values detected."
    )

# ============================================================
# 16. CHECK DUPLICATES
# ============================================================

original_duplicates = df[
    check_columns
].duplicated().sum()

print("\nDuplicate observations:")
print(original_duplicates)

# ============================================================
# 17. REMOVE ONLY TEMPORARY COLUMN
# ============================================================

df.drop(
    columns=["_Original_Row_Order"],
    inplace=True
)

# ============================================================
# 18. REORDER COLUMNS
# ============================================================

preferred_columns = [
    "Sequence_ID",
    student_col,
    "Time_Step"
]

remaining_columns = [
    col
    for col in df.columns
    if col not in preferred_columns
    and col != TARGET_COL
]

final_columns = (
    preferred_columns
    + pca_features
    + remaining_columns
    + [TARGET_COL]
)

# Remove duplicates while preserving order
final_columns = list(
    dict.fromkeys(final_columns)
)

df = df[
    final_columns
]

# ============================================================
# 19. FINAL SHAPE
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("FINAL SEQUENCE DATASET")
print("=" * 80)

print("\nFinal shape:")
print(df.shape)

print("\nExpected rows:")
print("10,000")

print("\nActual rows:")
print(len(df))

if len(df) != 10000:

    raise ValueError(
        "The number of observations changed!"
    )

# ============================================================
# 20. FINAL STUDENT COUNT
# ============================================================

print("\nUnique students:")
print(
    df[student_col].nunique()
)

# ============================================================
# 21. FINAL SEQUENCE COUNT
# ============================================================

print("\nNumber of sequences:")
print(
    df["Sequence_ID"].nunique()
)

# ============================================================
# 22. FINAL OBSERVATIONS PER SEQUENCE
# ============================================================

print("\nObservations per sequence:")

print(
    df.groupby("Sequence_ID")
      .size()
      .value_counts()
      .sort_index()
)

# ============================================================
# 23. TARGET DISTRIBUTION
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("TARGET DISTRIBUTION")
print("=" * 80)

print(
    df[TARGET_COL]
    .value_counts()
    .sort_index()
)

# ============================================================
# 24. FINAL MISSING VALUE CHECK
# ============================================================

print("\nFinal missing values:")
print(
    df.isna().sum().sum()
)

# ============================================================
# 25. FINAL DUPLICATE CHECK
# ============================================================

print("\nFinal duplicate rows:")
print(
    df.duplicated().sum()
)

# ============================================================
# 26. DISPLAY FIRST 10 ROWS
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("FIRST 10 ROWS")
print("=" * 80)

print(
    df.head(10).to_string()
)

# ============================================================
# 27. SAVE ONE CSV ONLY
# ============================================================

df.to_csv(
    OUTPUT_FILE,
    index=False
)

# ============================================================
# 28. VERIFY SAVED CSV
# ============================================================

if not os.path.exists(OUTPUT_FILE):

    raise IOError(
        "Output CSV was not created."
    )

saved_df = pd.read_csv(
    OUTPUT_FILE
)

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print(" COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY")
print("=" * 80)

print("\nSaved file:")
print(OUTPUT_FILE)

print("\nSaved dataset shape:")
print(saved_df.shape)

print("\nSaved observations:")
print(len(saved_df))

print("\nSaved students:")
print(
    saved_df[student_col].nunique()
)

print("\nSaved sequences:")
print(
    saved_df["Sequence_ID"].nunique()
)

print("\nObservations per sequence:")
print(
    saved_df.groupby("Sequence_ID")
    .size()
    .value_counts()
    .sort_index()
)
print("\n" + "=" * 80)

import os

import random

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import tensorflow as tf

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

from tensorflow.keras import Model, Input
from tensorflow.keras.layers import (
    Dense,
    Dropout,
    Add,
    SimpleRNN,
    Layer,
    TimeDistributed,
    Concatenate
)
from tensorflow.keras.optimizers import Adam
from tensorflow.keras.callbacks import (
    EarlyStopping,
    ReduceLROnPlateau
)
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


# ============================================================
# 1. PATH
# ============================================================

CSV_PATH = (
    r"E:\Projects\1_Material Manufacturing\Dataset\C_Dataset_sequence_feature_extracted.csv"
)


# ============================================================
# 2. REPRODUCIBILITY
# ============================================================

GLOBAL_SEED = 42

os.environ["PYTHONHASHSEED"] = str(GLOBAL_SEED)

random.seed(GLOBAL_SEED)
np.random.seed(GLOBAL_SEED)
tf.random.set_seed(GLOBAL_SEED)


# ============================================================
# 3. LOAD DATA
# ============================================================

df = pd.read_csv(CSV_PATH)

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("PROPOSED RES-ATTRRNN MODEL")

# ============================================================
# 4. IDENTIFY PCA FEATURES
# ============================================================

pca_cols = [
    c for c in df.columns
    if c.startswith("PCA_")
]

pca_cols = sorted(
    pca_cols,
    key=lambda x: int(x.split("_")[1])
)

target_col = "IEC_Alignment_Class"


# ============================================================
# 5. BASIC VALIDATION
# ============================================================

sequence_lengths = df.groupby("Sequence_ID").size()

# ============================================================
# 6. SORT DATA
# ============================================================

df = df.sort_values(
    ["Sequence_ID", "Time_Step"]
).reset_index(drop=True)


# ============================================================
# 7. CREATE SEQUENCE ARRAYS
# ============================================================

sequence_ids = sorted(
    df["Sequence_ID"].unique()
)

X_list = []
y_list = []
student_list = []
seq_list = []

for seq_id in sequence_ids:

    seq_df = df[
        df["Sequence_ID"] == seq_id
    ].sort_values("Time_Step")

    X_seq = seq_df[pca_cols].values.astype(np.float32)

    y_seq = seq_df[target_col].values.astype(np.float32)

    X_list.append(X_seq)
    y_list.append(y_seq)

    student_list.append(
        seq_df["Student_ID"].iloc[0]
    )

    seq_list.append(seq_id)


X = np.stack(X_list)
y = np.stack(y_list)

student_ids = np.array(student_list)
sequence_ids = np.array(seq_list)

# ============================================================
# 8. TRAIN / VALIDATION / TEST SPLIT
# STUDENT / SEQUENCE LEVEL
# ============================================================

all_indices = np.arange(len(sequence_ids))

train_idx, temp_idx = train_test_split(
    all_indices,
    test_size=0.30,
    random_state=42,
    shuffle=True
)

val_idx, test_idx = train_test_split(
    temp_idx,
    test_size=0.50,
    random_state=42,
    shuffle=True
)


X_train = X[train_idx]
X_val = X[val_idx]
X_test = X[test_idx]

y_train = y[train_idx]
y_val = y[val_idx]
y_test = y[test_idx]



# ============================================================
# 10. TEMPORAL ATTENTION
# ============================================================

class TemporalAttention(Layer):

    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(**kwargs)

        self.score_dense = Dense(
            1,
            activation="tanh"
        )

    def call(self, inputs):

        # inputs:
        # batch × time × hidden

        scores = self.score_dense(inputs)

        # batch × time × 1

        attention_weights = tf.nn.softmax(
            scores,
            axis=1
        )

        context = (
            attention_weights * inputs
        )

        context = tf.reduce_sum(
            context,
            axis=1
        )

        return context


# ============================================================
# 11. BUILD RES-ATTRRNN
# ============================================================

def build_res_attrnn(
    sequence_length,
    n_features
):

    inputs = Input(
        shape=(sequence_length, n_features),
        name="PCA_Sequence_Input"
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Flatten each time step for residual transformation
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    main = TimeDistributed(
        Dense(
            64,
            activation="relu"
        )
    )(inputs)

    main = TimeDistributed(
        Dense(
            64,
            activation="relu"
        )
    )(main)


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Residual shortcut
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    shortcut = TimeDistributed(
        Dense(
            64,
            activation=None
        )
    )(inputs)


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Residual addition
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    residual = Add()(
        [main, shortcut]
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Vanilla RNN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    rnn_output = SimpleRNN(
        64,
        activation="tanh",
        return_sequences=True,
        name="Vanilla_RNN"
    )(residual)


    rnn_output = Dropout(
        0.50
    )(rnn_output)


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Temporal Attention
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    attention = TemporalAttention(
        name="Temporal_Attention"
    )(rnn_output)


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Repeat attention context
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    attention_repeated = tf.keras.layers.RepeatVector(
        sequence_length
    )(attention)


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Preserve time-specific RNN representation
    # and combine with global temporal context
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    fused = Concatenate(
        axis=-1
    )([
        rnn_output,
        attention_repeated
    ])


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Fully connected output block
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    dense = TimeDistributed(
        Dense(
            64,
            activation="relu"
        )
    )(fused)

    dense = TimeDistributed(
        Dropout(0.50)
    )(dense)


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Observation-level binary prediction
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    outputs = TimeDistributed(
        Dense(
            1,
            activation="sigmoid"
        ),
        name="IEC_Alignment_Output"
    )(dense)


    model = Model(
        inputs=inputs,
        outputs=outputs,
        name="Res-AttRNN"
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Compile
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    model.compile(
        optimizer=Adam(
            learning_rate=0.001
        ),
        loss="binary_crossentropy"
    )

    return model


# ============================================================
# 12. CREATE MODEL
# ============================================================

model = build_res_attrnn(
    sequence_length=X_train.shape[1],
    n_features=X_train.shape[2]
)


print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("MODEL ARCHITECTURE")
print("=" * 80)

model.summary()


# ============================================================
# 13. CALLBACKS
# ============================================================

early_stop = EarlyStopping(
    monitor="val_loss",
    patience=10,
    restore_best_weights=True,
    verbose=1
)

reduce_lr = ReduceLROnPlateau(
    monitor="val_loss",
    factor=0.5,
    patience=5,
    min_lr=1e-6,
    verbose=1
)


# ============================================================
# 14. TRAIN MODEL
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("TRAINING RES-ATTRRNN")
print("=" * 80)

start_time = time.time()

history = model.fit(
    X_train,
    y_train[..., np.newaxis],
    validation_data=(
        X_val,
        y_val[..., np.newaxis]
    ),
    epochs=40,
    batch_size=32,
    callbacks=[
        early_stop,
        reduce_lr
    ],
    verbose=1
)

training_time_seconds = (
    time.time() - start_time
)

training_time_hours = (
    training_time_seconds / 3600
)


print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("TRAINING COMPLETED")
print("=" * 80)

y_pred = (
    y_prob >= 0.50
).astype(int)

# ============================================================
# 16. METRICS
# ============================================================

accuracy = accuracy_score(
    y_true,
    y_pred
)

precision = precision_score(
    y_true,
    y_pred,
    zero_division=0
)

recall = recall_score(
    y_true,
    y_pred,
    zero_division=0
)

f1 = f1_score(
    y_true,
    y_pred,
    zero_division=0
)

logloss = log_loss(
    y_true,
    y_prob,
    labels=[0, 1]
)

mae = mean_absolute_error(
    y_true,
    y_prob
)

auc_roc = roc_auc_score(
    y_true,
    y_prob
)

auc_pr = average_precision_score(
    y_true,
    y_prob
)


# ============================================================
# 17. CONFUSION MATRIX
# ============================================================

cm = confusion_matrix(
    y_true,
    y_pred,
    labels=[0, 1]
)

TN, FP, FN, TP = cm.ravel()


# ============================================================
# 18. SPECIFICITY + NPV
# ============================================================

specificity = (
    TN / (TN + FP)
    if (TN + FP) > 0
    else 0
)

npv = (
    TN / (TN + FN)
    if (TN + FN) > 0
    else 0
)


# ============================================================
# 19. PRINT FINAL RESULTS
# ============================================================

print("\n")
print("=" * 90)
print("FINAL RESULTS — RES-ATTRRNN")
print("=" * 90)

print(
    f"Accuracy (%)              : {accuracy * 100:.2f}"
)

print(
    f"Precision (%)             : {precision * 100:.2f}"
)

print(
    f"Recall / Sensitivity (%)  : {recall * 100:.2f}"
)

print(
    f"F1-Score (%)              : {f1 * 100:.2f}"
)

print(
    f"Log Loss                  : {logloss:.3f}"
)

print(
    f"MAE                       : {mae:.3f}"
)

print(
    f"AUC-PR                    : {auc_pr:.3f}"
)

print(
    f"AUC-ROC                   : {auc_roc:.3f}"
)

print(
    f"Training Time (hours)     : {training_time_hours:.2f}"
)

print(
    f"Specificity               : {specificity :.4f}"
)

print(
    f"NPV                       : {npv :.4f}"
)

# RANDOM-SEED ROBUSTNESS ANALYSIS

import os
import time
import random
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import tensorflow as tf

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    precision_score,
    recall_score,
    f1_score,
    log_loss,
    mean_absolute_error,
    roc_auc_score,
    average_precision_score,
    confusion_matrix
)

from tensorflow.keras.callbacks import (
    EarlyStopping,
    ReduceLROnPlateau
)


# ============================================================
# 1. RANDOM SEEDS FROM R1
# ============================================================

SEEDS = [42, 52, 62, 72, 82]

print("\n" + "=" * 100)
print("RANDOM-SEED ROBUSTNESS ANALYSIS")
print("=" * 100)

print("\nRandom seeds:")
print(SEEDS)


# ============================================================
# 2. METRIC FUNCTION
# ============================================================

def calculate_metrics(
    y_true,
    y_prob,
    training_time_hours
):

    y_true = np.asarray(
        y_true
    ).reshape(-1)

    y_prob = np.asarray(
        y_prob
    ).reshape(-1)

    y_pred = (
        y_prob >= 0.50
    ).astype(int)


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Classification metrics
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    accuracy = accuracy_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred
    )

    precision = precision_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        zero_division=0
    )

    recall = recall_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        zero_division=0
    )

    f1 = f1_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        zero_division=0
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Probability metrics
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    logloss = log_loss(
        y_true,
        y_prob,
        labels=[0, 1]
    )

    mae = mean_absolute_error(
        y_true,
        y_prob
    )

    auc_roc = roc_auc_score(
        y_true,
        y_prob
    )

    auc_pr = average_precision_score(
        y_true,
        y_prob
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Confusion matrix
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    cm = confusion_matrix(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        labels=[0, 1]
    )

    TN, FP, FN, TP = cm.ravel()


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Specificity
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    specificity = (
        TN / (TN + FP)
        if (TN + FP) > 0
        else 0
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # NPV
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    npv = (
        TN / (TN + FN)
        if (TN + FN) > 0
        else 0
    )


    return {
        "Accuracy (%)":
            accuracy * 100,

        "Precision (%)":
            precision * 100,

        "Recall/Sensitivity (%)":
            recall * 100,

        "F1-Score (%)":
            f1 * 100,

        "Log Loss":
            logloss,

        "MAE":
            mae,

        "AUC-PR":
            auc_pr,

        "AUC-ROC":
            auc_roc,

        "Specificity":
            specificity,

        "NPV":
            npv,

        "Training Time (h)":
            training_time_hours
    }


# ============================================================
# 3. STORAGE
# ============================================================

all_results = []


# ============================================================
# 4. RUN FIVE SEEDS
# ============================================================

for run_number, seed in enumerate(
    SEEDS,
    start=1
):

    print("\n\n")
    print("=" * 100)
    print(
        f"RUN {run_number} / {len(SEEDS)}"
    )
    print(
        f"Random Seed: {seed}"
    )
    print("=" * 100)


    # ========================================================
    # SET RANDOM SEED
    # ========================================================

    os.environ["PYTHONHASHSEED"] = str(seed)

    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    tf.random.set_seed(seed)


    # ========================================================
    # CLEAR PREVIOUS TF GRAPH
    # ========================================================

    tf.keras.backend.clear_session()


    # ========================================================
    # STUDENT / SEQUENCE LEVEL SPLIT
    # ========================================================

    all_indices = np.arange(
        len(sequence_ids)
    )


    train_idx_seed, temp_idx_seed = train_test_split(
        all_indices,
        test_size=0.30,
        random_state=seed,
        shuffle=True
    )


    val_idx_seed, test_idx_seed = train_test_split(
        temp_idx_seed,
        test_size=0.50,
        random_state=seed,
        shuffle=True
    )


    X_train_seed = X[
        train_idx_seed
    ]

    X_val_seed = X[
        val_idx_seed
    ]

    X_test_seed = X[
        test_idx_seed
    ]


    y_train_seed = y[
        train_idx_seed
    ]

    y_val_seed = y[
        val_idx_seed
    ]

    y_test_seed = y[
        test_idx_seed
    ]

    # ========================================================
    # BUILD MODEL
    # ========================================================

    model_seed = build_res_attrnn(
        sequence_length=X_train_seed.shape[1],
        n_features=X_train_seed.shape[2]
    )


    # ========================================================
    # CALLBACKS
    # ========================================================

    early_stop_seed = EarlyStopping(
        monitor="val_loss",
        patience=10,
        restore_best_weights=True,
        verbose=0
    )


    reduce_lr_seed = ReduceLROnPlateau(
        monitor="val_loss",
        factor=0.5,
        patience=5,
        min_lr=1e-6,
        verbose=0
    )


    # ========================================================
    # TRAIN
    # ========================================================

    print("\nTraining...")

    start_time = time.time()


    history_seed = model_seed.fit(
        X_train_seed,
        y_train_seed[..., np.newaxis],

        validation_data=(
            X_val_seed,
            y_val_seed[..., np.newaxis]
        ),

        epochs=100,

        batch_size=32,

        callbacks=[
            early_stop_seed,
            reduce_lr_seed
        ],

        verbose=0
    )


    training_time_seconds = (
        time.time() - start_time
    )

    training_time_hours = (
        training_time_seconds / 3600
    )

    # ========================================================
    # PREDICTION
    # ========================================================

    y_prob_seed = model_seed.predict(
        X_test_seed,
        verbose=0
    )


    # ========================================================
    # CALCULATE METRICS
    # ========================================================

    metrics_seed = calculate_metrics(
        y_test_seed,
        y_prob_seed,
        training_time_hours
    )


    # ========================================================
    # ADD RUN INFORMATION
    # ========================================================

    metrics_seed["Run"] = (
        f"Run {run_number}"
    )

    metrics_seed["Random Seed"] = seed


    all_results.append(
        metrics_seed
    )


    # ========================================================
    # PRINT CURRENT RUN
    # ========================================================

    print("\n" + "-" * 100)
    print(
        f"RESULTS — RUN {run_number} "
        f"(Seed = {seed})"
    )
    print("-" * 100)


    print(
        f"Accuracy (%)             : "
        f"{metrics_seed['Accuracy (%)']:.2f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Precision (%)            : "
        f"{metrics_seed['Precision (%)']:.2f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Recall/Sensitivity (%)   : "
        f"{metrics_seed['Recall/Sensitivity (%)']:.2f}"
    )

    print(
        f"F1-Score (%)             : "
        f"{metrics_seed['F1-Score (%)']:.2f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Log Loss                 : "
        f"{metrics_seed['Log Loss']:.3f}"
    )

    print(
        f"MAE                      : "
        f"{metrics_seed['MAE']:.3f}"
    )

    print(
        f"AUC-PR                   : "
        f"{metrics_seed['AUC-PR']:.3f}"
    )

    print(
        f"AUC-ROC                  : "
        f"{metrics_seed['AUC-ROC']:.3f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Specificity              : "
        f"{metrics_seed['Specificity']:.4f}"
    )

    print(
        f"NPV                      : "
        f"{metrics_seed['NPV']:.4f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Training Time (h)        : "
        f"{metrics_seed['Training Time (h)']:.2f}"
    )


# ============================================================
# 5. CREATE RESULTS DATAFRAME
# ============================================================

results_df = pd.DataFrame(
    all_results
)



# ============================================================
# 8. CALCULATE MEAN
# ============================================================

numeric_columns = [
    "Accuracy (%)",
    "Precision (%)",
    "Recall/Sensitivity (%)",
    "F1-Score (%)",
    "Log Loss",
    "MAE",

mean_values = (

std_values = (

# ============================================================

print("\n")

for metric in numeric_columns:

# ============================================================
# STEP 9
# 5-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION
# PROPOSED RES-ATTRRNN
# ============================================================

import os
import time
import random
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import tensorflow as tf

from sklearn.model_selection import KFold, train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    precision_score,
    recall_score,
    f1_score,
    log_loss,
    mean_absolute_error,
    roc_auc_score,
    average_precision_score,
    confusion_matrix
)

from tensorflow.keras.callbacks import (
    EarlyStopping,
    ReduceLROnPlateau
)


# ============================================================
# 1. SETTINGS
# ============================================================

N_SPLITS = 5
BASE_SEED = 42

print("\n" + "=" * 110)
print("5-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION — RES-ATTRRNN")
print("=" * 110)


# ============================================================
# 2. METRIC FUNCTION
# ============================================================

def calculate_cv_metrics(
    y_true,
    y_prob,
    training_time_hours
):

    y_true = np.asarray(
        y_true
    ).reshape(-1)

    y_prob = np.asarray(
        y_prob
    ).reshape(-1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Binary predictions
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    y_pred = (
        y_prob >= 0.50
    ).astype(int)


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Classification metrics
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    accuracy = accuracy_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred
    )

    precision = precision_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        zero_division=0
    )

    recall = recall_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        zero_division=0
    )

    f1 = f1_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        zero_division=0
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Probability-based metrics
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    logloss = log_loss(
        y_true,
        y_prob,
        labels=[0, 1]
    )

    mae = mean_absolute_error(
        y_true,
        y_prob
    )

    # Handle possible single-class fold safely
    if len(np.unique(y_true)) == 2:

        auc_roc = roc_auc_score(
            y_true,
            y_prob
        )

        auc_pr = average_precision_score(
            y_true,
            y_prob
        )

    else:

        auc_roc = np.nan
        auc_pr = np.nan


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Confusion matrix
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    cm = confusion_matrix(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        labels=[0, 1]
    )

    TN, FP, FN, TP = cm.ravel()


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Specificity
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    specificity = (
        TN / (TN + FP)
        if (TN + FP) > 0
        else 0
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # NPV
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    npv = (
        TN / (TN + FN)
        if (TN + FN) > 0
        else 0
    )


    return {

        "Accuracy (%)":
            accuracy * 100,

        "Precision (%)":
            precision * 100,

        "Recall/Sensitivity (%)":
            recall * 100,

        "F1-Score (%)":
            f1 * 100,

        "Log Loss":
            logloss,

        "MAE":
            mae,

        "AUC-PR":
            auc_pr,

        "AUC-ROC":
            auc_roc,

        "Specificity":
            specificity ,

        "NPV":
            npv ,

        "TN":
            TN,

        "FP":
            FP,

        "FN":
            FN,

        "TP":
            TP
    }

# ============================================================
# 4. K-FOLD OBJECT
# ============================================================

kf = KFold(
    n_splits=N_SPLITS,
    shuffle=True,
    random_state=BASE_SEED
)


# ============================================================
# 5. STORAGE
# ============================================================

fold_results = []


# ============================================================
# 6. FIVE FOLDS
# ============================================================

for fold_number, (
    train_val_idx,
    test_idx
) in enumerate(

    fold_seed = BASE_SEED + fold_number

        fold_seed
    )

    random.seed(
        fold_seed
    )

    np.random.seed(
        fold_seed
    )

    tf.random.set_seed(
        fold_seed
    )

    )


    # ========================================================

# ============================================================
# STEP 10
# STATISTICAL SIGNIFICANCE ANALYSIS
# t-value + p-value + 95% CI
# ============================================================

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import ttest_1samp, t


# ============================================================
# METRICS
# ============================================================

stat_metrics = [
    "Accuracy (%)",
    "Precision (%)",
    "Recall/Sensitivity (%)",
    "F1-Score (%)",
    "Log Loss",
    "MAE",
    "AUC-PR",
    "AUC-ROC",
    "Specificity",
    "NPV"
]


# ============================================================
# REFERENCE VALUES
# ============================================================

reference_values = {

    "Accuracy (%)": 95.0,

    "Precision (%)": 95.0,

    "Recall/Sensitivity (%)": 95.0,

    "F1-Score (%)": 95.0,

    "Log Loss": 0.0,

    "MAE": 0.0,

    "AUC-PR": 0.50,

    "AUC-ROC": 0.50,

    "Specificity": 95.0,

    "NPV": 95.0
}


# ============================================================
# STORAGE
# ============================================================

statistical_results = []


# ============================================================
# CALCULATE STATISTICS
# ============================================================

for metric in stat_metrics:

    values = (
        fold_results_df[metric]
        .astype(float)
        .values
    )

    n = len(values)

    mean_value = np.mean(
        values
    )

    std_value = np.std(
        values,
        ddof=1
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # One-sample t-test
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    reference = reference_values[
        metric
    ]

    t_value, p_value = ttest_1samp(
        values,
        popmean=reference
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 95% confidence interval
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    standard_error = (
        std_value /
        np.sqrt(n)
    )

    t_critical = t.ppf(
        0.975,
        df=n - 1
    )

    margin_error = (
        t_critical *
        standard_error
    )

    ci_lower = (
        mean_value -
        margin_error
    )

    ci_upper = (
        mean_value +
        margin_error
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Statistical decision
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if p_value < 0.05:

        decision = (
            "Significant"
        )

    else:

        decision = (
            "Not Significant"
        )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Store
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    statistical_results.append({

        "Metric":
            metric,

        "Mean ± SD (Proposed)":
            f"{mean_value:.4f} ± {std_value:.4f}",

        "t-value":
            f"{t_value:.3f}",

        "p-value":
            f"{p_value:.3f}",

        "95% Confidence Interval":
            f"[{ci_lower:.4f}, {ci_upper:.4f}]",

        "Statistical Decision":
            decision
    })


# ============================================================
# DATAFRAME
# ============================================================

statistical_df = pd.DataFrame(
    statistical_results
)


# ============================================================
# PRINT COMPLETE TABLE
# ============================================================

print("\n")
print("=" * 130)
print("STATISTICAL SIGNIFICANCE ANALYSIS")
print("=" * 130)

print(
    statistical_df.to_string(
        index=False
    )
)
print("\n")
print("=" * 100)
print("COMPLETED")
print("=" * 100)
