# ============================================================
# STEP 11
# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS
# PROPOSED RES-ATTRRNN
# ============================================================

import os
import time
import random
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import tensorflow as tf

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    precision_score,
    recall_score,
    f1_score,
    log_loss,
    mean_absolute_error,
    roc_auc_score,
    average_precision_score,
    confusion_matrix
)

from tensorflow.keras import Model, Input
from tensorflow.keras.layers import (
    Dense,
    Dropout,
    Add,
    SimpleRNN,
    TimeDistributed,
    Concatenate,
    RepeatVector,
    Layer
)

from tensorflow.keras.optimizers import Adam

from tensorflow.keras.callbacks import (
    EarlyStopping,
    ReduceLROnPlateau
)


# ============================================================
# 1. SETTINGS
# ============================================================

SEED = 42

np.random.seed(SEED)
random.seed(SEED)
tf.random.set_seed(SEED)

print("\n" + "=" * 110)
print("SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS — RES-ATTRRNN")
print("=" * 110)


# ============================================================
# 2. METRIC FUNCTION
# ============================================================

def calculate_sensitivity_metrics(
    y_true,
    y_prob
):

    y_true = np.asarray(
        y_true
    ).reshape(-1)

    y_prob = np.asarray(
        y_prob
    ).reshape(-1)

    y_pred = (
        y_prob >= 0.50
    ).astype(int)


    accuracy = accuracy_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred
    )

    precision = precision_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        zero_division=0
    )

    recall = recall_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        zero_division=0
    )

    f1 = f1_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        zero_division=0
    )

    logloss = log_loss(
        y_true,
        y_prob,
        labels=[0, 1]
    )

    mae = mean_absolute_error(
        y_true,
        y_prob
    )

    auc_roc = roc_auc_score(
        y_true,
        y_prob
    )

    auc_pr = average_precision_score(
        y_true,
        y_prob
    )

    cm = confusion_matrix(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        labels=[0, 1]
    )

    TN, FP, FN, TP = cm.ravel()

    specificity = (
        TN / (TN + FP)
        if (TN + FP) > 0
        else 0
    )

    npv = (
        TN / (TN + FN)
        if (TN + FN) > 0
        else 0
    )

    return {

        "Accuracy (%)":
            accuracy * 100,

        "Precision (%)":
            precision * 100,

        "Recall/Sensitivity (%)":
            recall * 100,

        "F1-Score (%)":
            f1 * 100,

        "Log Loss":
            logloss,

        "MAE":
            mae,

        "AUC-PR":
            auc_pr,

        "AUC-ROC":
            auc_roc,

        "Specificity (%)":
            specificity * 100,

        "NPV (%)":
            npv * 100
    }


# ============================================================
# 3. PRINT RESULT FUNCTION
# ============================================================

def print_sensitivity_result(
    name,
    metrics
):

    print("-" * 100)

    print(
        f"Configuration            : {name}"
    )

    print(
        f"Accuracy (%)             : "
        f"{metrics['Accuracy (%)']:.2f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Precision (%)            : "
        f"{metrics['Precision (%)']:.2f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Recall/Sensitivity (%)   : "
        f"{metrics['Recall/Sensitivity (%)']:.2f}"
    )

    print(
        f"F1-Score (%)             : "
        f"{metrics['F1-Score (%)']:.2f}"
    )

    print(
        f"AUC-PR                   : "
        f"{metrics['AUC-PR']:.3f}"
    )

    print(
        f"AUC-ROC                  : "
        f"{metrics['AUC-ROC']:.3f}"
    )


# ============================================================
# 4. CREATE A FLEXIBLE MODEL
# ============================================================

def build_sensitivity_model(
    sequence_length,
    n_features,
    use_residual=True,
    use_attention=True,
    use_rnn=True
):

    inputs = Input(
        shape=(
            sequence_length,
            n_features
        )
    )


    # ========================================================
    # BACKBONE
    # ========================================================

    if use_rnn:

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Residual branch
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        if use_residual:

            main = TimeDistributed(
                Dense(
                    64,
                    activation="relu"
                )
            )(inputs)

            main = TimeDistributed(
                Dense(
                    64,
                    activation="relu"
                )
            )(main)

            shortcut = TimeDistributed(
                Dense(
                    64
                )
            )(inputs)

            features = Add()(
                [main, shortcut]
            )

        else:

            features = TimeDistributed(
                Dense(
                    64,
                    activation="relu"
                )
            )(inputs)


        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # RNN
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        rnn_output = SimpleRNN(
            64,
            activation="tanh",
            return_sequences=True
        )(features)


        rnn_output = Dropout(
            0.50
        )(rnn_output)


        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Attention
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        if use_attention:

            scores = Dense(
                1,
                activation="tanh"
            )(rnn_output)

            weights = tf.nn.softmax(
                scores,
                axis=1
            )

            context = (
                weights *
                rnn_output
            )

            context = tf.reduce_sum(
                context,
                axis=1
            )

            context = RepeatVector(
                sequence_length
            )(context)

            combined = Concatenate(
                axis=-1
            )([
                rnn_output,
                context
            ])

        else:

            combined = rnn_output


    # ========================================================
    # NON-RECURRENT TABULAR BACKBONE
    # ========================================================

    else:

        if use_residual:

            main = TimeDistributed(
                Dense(
                    64,
                    activation="relu"
                )
            )(inputs)

            main = TimeDistributed(
                Dense(
                    64,
                    activation="relu"
                )
            )(main)

            shortcut = TimeDistributed(
                Dense(
                    64
                )
            )(inputs)

            combined = Add()(
                [main, shortcut]
            )

        else:

            combined = TimeDistributed(
                Dense(
                    64,
                    activation="relu"
                )
            )(inputs)


    # ========================================================
    # OUTPUT
    # ========================================================

    dense = TimeDistributed(
        Dense(
            64,
            activation="relu"
        )
    )(combined)

    dense = TimeDistributed(
        Dropout(0.50)
    )(dense)

    outputs = TimeDistributed(
        Dense(
            1,
            activation="sigmoid"
        )
    )(dense)


    model = Model(
        inputs,
        outputs
    )


    model.compile(
        optimizer=Adam(
            learning_rate=0.001
        ),
        loss="binary_crossentropy"
    )


    return model


# ============================================================
# 5. TRAIN + TEST FUNCTION
# ============================================================

def run_configuration(
    X_data,
    y_data,
    use_residual=True,
    use_attention=True,
    use_rnn=True
):

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Sequence-level split
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    indices = np.arange(
        len(X_data)
    )

    train_idx, temp_idx = train_test_split(
        indices,
        test_size=0.30,
        random_state=SEED,
        shuffle=True
    )

    val_idx, test_idx = train_test_split(
        temp_idx,
        test_size=0.50,
        random_state=SEED,
        shuffle=True
    )


    X_train = X_data[
        train_idx
    ]

    X_val = X_data[
        val_idx
    ]

    X_test = X_data[
        test_idx
    ]


    y_train = y_data[
        train_idx
    ]

    y_val = y_data[
        val_idx
    ]

    y_test = y_data[
        test_idx
    ]


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Build
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    tf.keras.backend.clear_session()

    model = build_sensitivity_model(

        sequence_length=X_train.shape[1],

        n_features=X_train.shape[2],

        use_residual=use_residual,

        use_attention=use_attention,

        use_rnn=use_rnn
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Callbacks
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    early_stop = EarlyStopping(
        monitor="val_loss",
        patience=10,
        restore_best_weights=True,
        verbose=0
    )

    reduce_lr = ReduceLROnPlateau(
        monitor="val_loss",
        factor=0.5,
        patience=5,
        min_lr=1e-6,
        verbose=0
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Train
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    start = time.time()

    model.fit(

        X_train,

        y_train[..., np.newaxis],

        validation_data=(

            X_val,

            y_val[..., np.newaxis]

        ),

        epochs=100,

        batch_size=32,

        callbacks=[
            early_stop,
            reduce_lr
        ],

        verbose=0
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Predict
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    y_prob = model.predict(
        X_test,
        verbose=0
    )


    metrics = calculate_sensitivity_metrics(
        y_test,
        y_prob
    )


    training_time = (
        time.time() - start
    ) / 3600


    return metrics, training_time


# ============================================================
# 6. BASELINE DATA
# ============================================================

X_original = X.copy()
y_original = y.copy()

# ============================================================
# STEP 12
# COMPONENT ABLATION STUDY
# RES-ATTRRNN
# ============================================================

import os
import time
import random
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import tensorflow as tf

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import (
    log_loss,
    mean_absolute_error,
    roc_auc_score,
    average_precision_score,
    accuracy_score,
    precision_score,
    recall_score,
    f1_score,
    confusion_matrix
)

from tensorflow.keras import (
    Model,
    Input
)

from tensorflow.keras.layers import (
    Dense,
    Dropout,
    Add,
    SimpleRNN,
    TimeDistributed,
    Concatenate,
    RepeatVector
)

from tensorflow.keras.optimizers import Adam

from tensorflow.keras.callbacks import (
    EarlyStopping,
    ReduceLROnPlateau
)


# ============================================================
# 1. SETTINGS
# ============================================================

SEED = 42

os.environ["PYTHONHASHSEED"] = str(SEED)

random.seed(SEED)
np.random.seed(SEED)
tf.random.set_seed(SEED)


print("\n")
print("=" * 120)
print("ABLATION STUDY — RES-ATTRRNN")
print("=" * 120)


# ============================================================
# 2. METRIC FUNCTION
# ============================================================

def calculate_ablation_metrics(
    y_true,
    y_prob
):

    y_true = np.asarray(
        y_true
    ).reshape(-1)

    y_prob = np.asarray(
        y_prob
    ).reshape(-1)

    y_pred = (
        y_prob >= 0.50
    ).astype(int)


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Main classification metrics
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    accuracy = accuracy_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred
    )

    precision = precision_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        zero_division=0
    )

    recall = recall_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        zero_division=0
    )

    f1 = f1_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        zero_division=0
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Required R1 metrics
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    logloss = log_loss(
        y_true,
        y_prob,
        labels=[0, 1]
    )

    mae = mean_absolute_error(
        y_true,
        y_prob
    )

    auc_pr = average_precision_score(
        y_true,
        y_prob
    )

    auc_roc = roc_auc_score(
        y_true,
        y_prob
    )


    return {

        "Accuracy (%)":
            accuracy * 100,

        "Precision (%)":
            precision * 100,

        "Recall/Sensitivity (%)":
            recall * 100,

        "F1-Score (%)":
            f1 * 100,

        "Log Loss":
            logloss,

        "MAE":
            mae,

        "AUC-PR":
            auc_pr,

        "AUC-ROC":
            auc_roc
    }


# ============================================================
# 3. ABLATION MODEL
# ============================================================

def build_ablation_model(
    sequence_length,
    n_features,
    residual=True,
    attention=True,
    rnn=True
):

    inputs = Input(
        shape=(
            sequence_length,
            n_features
        ),
        name="Input"
    )


    # ========================================================
    # NON-RECURRENT BACKBONE
    # ========================================================

    if not rnn:

        if residual:

            main = TimeDistributed(
                Dense(
                    64,
                    activation="relu"
                )
            )(inputs)

            main = TimeDistributed(
                Dense(
                    64,
                    activation="relu"
                )
            )(main)

            shortcut = TimeDistributed(
                Dense(
                    64
                )
            )(inputs)

            features = Add()(
                [
                    main,
                    shortcut
                ]
            )

        else:

            features = TimeDistributed(
                Dense(
                    64,
                    activation="relu"
                )
            )(inputs)


    # ========================================================
    # RECURRENT BACKBONE
    # ========================================================

    else:

        if residual:

            main = TimeDistributed(
                Dense(
                    64,
                    activation="relu"
                )
            )(inputs)

            main = TimeDistributed(
                Dense(
                    64,
                    activation="relu"
                )
            )(main)

            shortcut = TimeDistributed(
                Dense(
                    64
                )
            )(inputs)

            features = Add()(
                [
                    main,
                    shortcut
                ]
            )

        else:

            features = TimeDistributed(
                Dense(
                    64,
                    activation="relu"
                )
            )(inputs)


        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # RNN
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        features = SimpleRNN(
            64,
            activation="tanh",
            return_sequences=True,
            name="RNN"
        )(features)

        features = Dropout(
            0.50
        )(features)


        # ====================================================
        # ATTENTION
        # ====================================================

        if attention:

            scores = Dense(
                1,
                activation="tanh"
            )(features)

            weights = tf.nn.softmax(
                scores,
                axis=1
            )

            context = (
                weights *
                features
            )

            context = tf.reduce_sum(
                context,
                axis=1
            )

            context = RepeatVector(
                sequence_length
            )(context)

            features = Concatenate(
                axis=-1
            )(
                [
                    features,
                    context
                ]
            )


    # ========================================================
    # OUTPUT
    # ========================================================

    features = TimeDistributed(
        Dense(
            64,
            activation="relu"
        )
    )(features)

    features = TimeDistributed(
        Dropout(
            0.50
        )
    )(features)

    outputs = TimeDistributed(
        Dense(
            1,
            activation="sigmoid"
        )
    )(features)


    model = Model(
        inputs=inputs,
        outputs=outputs
    )


    model.compile(
        optimizer=Adam(
            learning_rate=0.001
        ),
        loss="binary_crossentropy"
    )


    return model


# ============================================================
# 4. FIXED TRAIN / VALIDATION / TEST SPLIT
# ============================================================

all_indices = np.arange(
    len(X)
)


train_idx, temp_idx = train_test_split(
    all_indices,
    test_size=0.30,
    random_state=SEED,
    shuffle=True
)


val_idx, test_idx = train_test_split(
    temp_idx,
    test_size=0.50,
    random_state=SEED,
    shuffle=True
)


X_train = X[
    train_idx
]

X_val = X[
    val_idx
]

X_test = X[
    test_idx
]


y_train = y[
    train_idx
]

y_val = y[
    val_idx
]

y_test = y[
    test_idx
]


# ============================================================
# 5. CONFIGURATION FUNCTION
# ============================================================

def run_ablation_configuration(
    configuration,
    residual=True,
    attention=True,
    rnn=True,
    X_input=None,
    y_input=None
):

    print("=" * 100)
    print(
        "Running:",
        configuration
    )
    print("=" * 100)


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Build model
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    tf.keras.backend.clear_session()

    model = build_ablation_model(
        sequence_length=X_input.shape[1],
        n_features=X_input.shape[2],
        residual=residual,
        attention=attention,
        rnn=rnn
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Callbacks
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    early_stop = EarlyStopping(
        monitor="val_loss",
        patience=10,
        restore_best_weights=True,
        verbose=0
    )

    reduce_lr = ReduceLROnPlateau(
        monitor="val_loss",
        factor=0.5,
        patience=5,
        min_lr=1e-6,
        verbose=0
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Train
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    start_time = time.time()


    model.fit(

        X_input[train_idx],

        y_input[
            train_idx
        ][..., np.newaxis],

        validation_data=(

            X_input[val_idx],

            y_input[
                val_idx
            ][..., np.newaxis]

        ),

        epochs=100,

        batch_size=32,

        callbacks=[
            early_stop,
            reduce_lr
        ],

        verbose=0
    )


    training_time_hours = (
        time.time() -
        start_time
    ) / 3600


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Test prediction
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    y_prob = model.predict(
        X_input[test_idx],
        verbose=0
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Metrics
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    metrics = calculate_ablation_metrics(
        y_input[test_idx],
        y_prob
    )


    metrics[
        "Configuration"
    ] = configuration

    metrics[
        "Training Time (h)"
    ] = training_time_hours


    return metrics

# ============================================================
# FEATURE IMPORTANCE FROM C_Dataset.csv
# Target: IEC_Alignment_Class
# ============================================================

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.impute import KNNImputer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, LabelEncoder
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.inspection import permutation_importance


# ============================================================
# PATHS
# ============================================================

CSV_PATH = r"E:\Projects\1_Material Manufacturing\Dataset\C_Dataset.csv"


# ============================================================
# LOAD DATA
# ============================================================

df = pd.read_csv(CSV_PATH,nrows=10)

# ============================================================
# TARGET
# ============================================================

TARGET = "IEC_Alignment_Class"

if TARGET not in df.columns:
    raise ValueError(
        f"Target column '{TARGET}' not found."
    )


# ============================================================
# SEPARATE TARGET
# ============================================================

X = df.drop(columns=[TARGET]).copy()
y = df[TARGET].copy()


# ============================================================
# IDENTIFY NUMERIC FEATURES
# ============================================================

numeric_features = X.select_dtypes(
    include=np.number
).columns.tolist()

non_numeric_features = [
    col for col in X.columns
    if col not in numeric_features
]


# ============================================================
# NUMERIC DATA ONLY
# ============================================================

X_numeric = X[numeric_features].copy()


# ============================================================
# REMOVE INF VALUES
# ============================================================

X_numeric = X_numeric.replace(
    [np.inf, -np.inf],
    np.nan
)


# ============================================================
# KNN IMPUTATION
# ============================================================

imputer = KNNImputer(
    n_neighbors=5
)

X_imputed = imputer.fit_transform(
    X_numeric
)

X_imputed = pd.DataFrame(
    X_imputed,
    columns=numeric_features,
    index=X_numeric.index
)


# ============================================================
# STANDARDIZATION
# ============================================================

scaler = StandardScaler()

X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(
    X_imputed
)

X_scaled = pd.DataFrame(
    X_scaled,
    columns=numeric_features,
    index=X_numeric.index
)


# ============================================================
# TARGET ENCODING
# ============================================================

if y.dtype == "object":

    label_encoder = LabelEncoder()

    y_encoded = label_encoder.fit_transform(y.astype(str))

   
else:

    y_encoded = y.values


# ============================================================
# TRAIN / TEST SPLIT
# ============================================================

X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X_scaled,
    y_encoded,
    test_size=0.20,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_encoded
)


# ============================================================
# RANDOM FOREST
# ============================================================

rf_model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    class_weight="balanced"
)

rf_model.fit(
    X_train,
    y_train
)


# ============================================================
# GINI FEATURE IMPORTANCE
# ============================================================

gini_importance = rf_model.feature_importances_


# ============================================================
# PERMUTATION FEATURE IMPORTANCE
# ============================================================

perm = permutation_importance(
    rf_model,
    X_test,
    y_test,
    n_repeats=10,
    random_state=42,
    scoring="accuracy",
    n_jobs=-1
)


# ============================================================
# FEATURE IMPORTANCE TABLE
# ============================================================

importance_df = pd.DataFrame({

    "Feature":
        numeric_features,

    "Gini_Importance":
        gini_importance,

    "Permutation_Importance":
        perm.importances_mean,

    "Permutation_Std":
        perm.importances_std

})


# ============================================================
# IMPORTANCE PERCENTAGE
# ============================================================

importance_df["Importance_Percentage"] = (
    importance_df["Gini_Importance"]
    /
    importance_df["Gini_Importance"].sum()
    * 100
)


# ============================================================
# SORT BY IMPORTANCE
# ============================================================

importance_df = importance_df.sort_values(
    "Gini_Importance",
    ascending=False
).reset_index(drop=True)




# ============================================================
# FEATURE IMPORTANCE GRAPH
# ============================================================

plot_df = importance_df.sort_values(
    "Gini_Importance",
    ascending=True
)


plt.figure(
    figsize=(11, 8)
)

plt.barh(
    plot_df["Feature"],
    plot_df["Gini_Importance"]
)

plt.xlabel(
    "Feature Importance",
    fontsize=14,
    fontweight="bold"
)

plt.ylabel(
    "Features",
    fontsize=14,
    fontweight="bold"
)

plt.title(
    "Feature Importance for IEC Alignment Classification",
    fontsize=16,
    fontweight="bold"
)

plt.xticks(
    fontsize=11
)

plt.yticks(
    fontsize=11
)

plt.grid(
    axis="x",
    linestyle=":",
    alpha=0.25
)

plt.tight_layout()

plt.show()
